title: Bitmap encoding/decoding
description: Implement SCHC ACK bitmap encoding and decoding. Acceptance: encodes/decodes bitmaps per RFC 8724, handles variable window sizes.
notes: Verified fixed-profile RFC 8724 ACK bitmap parity across Python and Rust: W=0/1, C=1 empty bitmap, C=0 all-zero/all-one/mixed, all 64 trailing-one boundaries with exact canonical wire lengths, maximum 63-bit bitmap, nonzero padding/overlong/noncanonical rejection, and semantic consumption of shared schc_adaptation vectors. Gates: Python SCHC pytest 539 passed; Ruff passed; Rust lichen-schc all-features tests passed; cargo check no-default-features with and without raw-fragment-codec passed; cargo fmt check passed; Clippy all-targets/all-features -D warnings passed. Batch code review intentionally deferred per wave protocol.
close_reason: Implemented and cross-implementation validation is green
